claims.text: These three artifacts describe one and the same trip: EV-TRIP-00110 (trip_record), EV-GPS-00110 (gps_trace) and EV-FARE-00110 (fare_breakdown) each carry trip_id TRP-00110 and the same accepted/start window on 22 July 2026. The first limb of the rider's burden under POL-RD-08(a) is therefore satisfied and the tribunal can move to the excess question.

The driver's own trace is impaired over precisely the stretch the rider disputes. EV-GPS-00110 carries a single 428-second gap from 18:35:00 to 18:42:08, bounded by fixes 6.90 km apart in a straight line, which is the whole KPE tunnel segment covered by the fare. Under POL-RD-07 that gap is over the 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired for POLICY purposes and not merely by the admissibility pre-pass. I rely on this artifact knowing it is down-weighted to 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE.

Even measured the POL-RD-07(i) way - the straight line across the bounding fixes, the reading most favourable to the driver - the excess on EV-GPS-00110 comes out at 2.8 km, 15.2% of the 18.4 km optimal carried on EV-TRIP-00110. That figure is a floor on the distance driven across the gap, not a measurement of it: the admissibility record for EV-GPS-00110 states that a surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km, which is over the POL-RD-01 gate. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings, so the threshold test cannot be safely run either way.

POL-RD-07(ii) allows a deviation to be established on an impaired trace only if an INDEPENDENT source corroborates it, and there is none. EV-CHAT-00110 contains no driver admission, only the driver's 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok'; erp_gantries on EV-FARE-00110 is null, so the gantry route check cannot be run; and trip_record.actual_distance_km on EV-TRIP-00110 is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as circular. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00110 is impaired at 0.6 (TRUNCATED_LOG) and EV-FARE-00110 at 0.75 (PARTIAL_RECORD).

The reason the driver cannot be contradicted in chat is a platform failure, not a rider failure: EV-CHAT-00110 is flagged truncated and its last_message_at is 18:26:14, 2186 seconds before the trip ended at 19:02:40. Everything said while the vehicle was inside the disputed tunnel segment is simply absent from the export, so the missing corroboration is a data gap on the record before us.

No traffic advisory covers the KPE or the ECP in the 18:19-19:02 window: EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING, a null payload at weight 0.0. Its absence is itself citable, and it means POL-RD-03 is unavailable to the driver - neither the extra distance nor the duration overrun can be laid at the door of a closure on this record.

POL-RD-04 is likewise unavailable to the driver. The rider gave no detour instruction: both messages on EV-CHAT-00110 carry waypoint_hint null, no road is named by the rider, and the rider's 'ok' merely answers the driver's own 'going KPE', which is the booked optimal corridor described on EV-TRIP-00110 as KPE then ECP, not a departure from it. There is nothing to exonerate on this limb.

POL-RD-05 cannot apply either: EV-TRIP-00110 shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, amended_optimal_distance_km null and amended_optimal_duration_min null. No amended endpoint and no re-quote exist, so the booked 18.4 km optimal distance governs and no part of the measured excess is excluded on that ground.

The enhanced corroboration requirement in POL-RD-08 is not engaged against this rider: EV-RPROF-00110 shows rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d of 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated of 0, far below the 4 the clause names. This is not a serial claimant whose word needs buttressing beyond the ordinary trace.

The $34.42 charge rests on the same single impaired measurement the rider is contesting. distance_charged_km of 21.20 on EV-FARE-00110 is identical to the 21.20 trace figure on EV-GPS-00110, and the platform's own pre-pass says so, so the ledger adds no independent evidence of distance. EV-FARE-00110 is impaired at 0.75 with issue code PARTIAL_RECORD. A charge whose only basis is an artifact that cannot see the disputed segment is not a charge the rider should be left carrying.

The duration is unexplained on this record. EV-TRIP-00110 records actual_duration_min of 39.0 against a booked optimal of 26.0 on a corridor the platform itself calls KPE then ECP - half again as long. With EV-ADVIS-00110-01 absent, erp_gantries null and the chat truncated, nothing in the bundle accounts for that overrun, and it is a further reason the present record cannot settle whether the vehicle stayed on the booked corridor.

On this record the correct outcome is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION. The trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c); no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists; and POL-RD-07(iii) directs that absence of proof on an impaired trace is a data failure rather than a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory, and escalation holds the disputed $34.42 rather than collecting it.

Independently, POL-GEN-02(2) caps the confidence of any ruling that rests on the excess figure at the weight of the artifact carrying it - EV-GPS-00110 at 0.39. That is below the platform-wide floor of 0.70, so the case escalates automatically under POL-RD-10(1) even before the corroboration point is reached, and the ruling must name the artifact, its 0.39 weight and the codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE.

claims.text: No route deviation is established on the governing figure, and the outcome is NO_ACTION. POL-RD-01 measures excess as trace distance less optimal distance: 21.2 km minus 18.4 km is 2.8 km, which is 15.2% of optimal, and the clause requires the excess to exceed BOTH 20% of optimal and 0.8 km. The percentage gate fails, so the deviation is not established however the rider characterises the trip. The trace artifact is impaired (weight 0.39; issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE) and I rely on it with that impairment disclosed; the optimal figure comes from the trip record, which is clean.

The rider's own arithmetic does not reach the gate either. He pleads that the route 'is 18-19 km' against the 21.2 km charged, i.e. an excess of at most about 3 km on an 18.4 km optimal, roughly 16% - still short of POL-RD-01's 20% threshold. Taking the rider's case at its highest, both establishment tests cannot be met, so there is nothing to refund. The trace is impaired (weight 0.39; issues GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE) and is cited with that impairment disclosed.

The trace is impaired FOR POLICY PURPOSES under POL-RD-07(a): a single 428-second gap between consecutive fixes, far over the clause's 90-second limb, bounded by the Defu Flyover and Kallang portal fixes and covering the entire segment the rider disputes. POL-RD-07(i) directs that excess across an impaired stretch be measured as the straight line between the bounding fixes - expressly 'the reading most favourable to the driver' - and on that reading the trip is 21.2 km, below the POL-RD-01 threshold. Correctly applied, the impairment confirms the no-deviation result rather than disturbing it.

The rider bears the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold, measured from an unimpaired trace or from an independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii). He has neither: the only distance measurement in the bundle is the impaired trace, and its prescribed reading gives 2.8 km / 15.2%, under the gate. His complaint that the timing 'does not make sense' is a duration point, and duration appears nowhere in POL-RD-01's establishment test - a slow run on a correctly followed corridor is not a route deviation. No burden ever shifts to the driver.

The driver drove the platform's own optimal corridor, not a detour away from it. The trip record's routing engine (routing-engine-v3.2, LTA traffic snapshot 18:19) gives the optimal route as 'KPE then ECP, crossing both gantries' - the expressway the driver reports taking and the same corridor the rider's own claim names. A route that runs along the optimal corridor cannot deviate from it, and the residual 2.8 km is the ordinary ramp, merge and lane-change slack that POL-RD-01's single numeric gate exists to disregard.

The driver announced the route in the app before the vehicle reached the tunnel - 'going KPE ah boss' - and the rider answered 'ok'. The rider therefore knew the expressway route and raised no objection at the time; his statement that he 'was on my phone' explains why he did not watch the route, not why the route was wrong. The chat artifact is impaired (weight 0.6; issue code TRUNCATED_LOG, the export ending at 18:26:14) and I rely on it with that impairment disclosed; even discounting it, the exchange appears on the surviving page.

The $3.00 of ERP the rider disputes is properly chargeable. The trip record's optimal_route_erp_sgd is 3.00 and the platform's own optimal route crosses both gantries, so the toll sits on the optimal corridor the driver drove. The fare breakdown's erp_gantries is null, so under POL-RD-09(4) the gantry match is undecidable on the record, the line is treated as matched, and no billing-integrity refund arises - there is no phantom gantry here. The fare artifact is impaired (weight 0.75; issue code PARTIAL_RECORD) and is cited with that impairment disclosed.

Even if POL-RD-06 is consulted on a finely balanced record, no repeat-deviation pattern is established. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 744, so neither the three-flag test nor the 0.05 ratio test (with at least 40 completed trips) is met. No FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) can follow.

In the alternative, if the tunnel dropout is held to leave the excess genuinely unmeasurable, the only permissible route is ESCALATE, not a refund. POL-RD-07(ii)-(iii) require independent corroboration of any deviation and direct ESCALATE where none exists: the truncated chat contains no driver admission, erp_gantries is null, and trip_record.actual_distance_km is a copy of the impaired trace, so no POL-RD-07(ii) source is available. Under POL-RD-10(3) the disputed amount is then held rather than refunded while a human reviews it. Either way the driver is not required to return the fare.

The present payment state is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00. Under POL-GEN-03, NO_ACTION leaves fare_breakdown.payment_status and refund_issued_sgd exactly as they are, so on this rider-filed dispute a finding of no deviation means the fare stands and no money moves to the rider - the outcome the driver seeks. The fare artifact is impaired (weight 0.75; issue code PARTIAL_RECORD), disclosed here.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this case goes to a human reviewer. No refund is issued and no charge is confirmed while that review is pending; the disputed $34.42 is held rather than collected or refunded.

THE MEASUREMENT PROBLEM. The only distance measurement in the bundle is the driver-side GPS trace, EV-GPS-00110. It contains a single 428-second gap between consecutive fixes (18:35:00 to 18:42:08), bounded by fixes 6.90 km apart, and that gap covers exactly the KPE stretch in dispute. That is far over POL-RD-07's 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired FOR POLICY PURPOSES, not merely flagged by the admissibility pre-pass (which also records LOW_COVERAGE at 81.7%). Its weight is 0.39 and its issue codes are GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE. Full disclosure under POL-GEN-02: a ruling resting on this figure cannot exceed 0.39, and that is below the 0.70 platform floor, so POL-RD-10(1) fires as well.

WHY NO_ACTION CANNOT ISSUE. Measured the POL-RD-07(i) way - the straight line between the bounding fixes, the reading most favourable to the driver - the trip is 21.20 km against the 18.40 km optimal on EV-TRIP-00110: an excess of 2.80 km, or 15.2%, under POL-RD-01's 20% (3.68 km) and 0.8 km gates. The driver's arithmetic on that reading is correct. But 21.20 km is a floor across a stretch the trace cannot see, not a measurement of it: a surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km and over the gate, and nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings. Because the trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) and no independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists, POL-RD-07(iii) is explicit that the claim is not sustained AND that the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION - the absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that mandatory.

WHY THERE IS NO CORROBORATION. I checked each POL-RD-07(ii) source. EV-CHAT-00110 contains no driver admission; it is itself impaired (weight 0.60, issue TRUNCATED_LOG) and ends at 18:26:14, 2186 seconds before the trip ended, so anything said inside the tunnel is simply absent. EV-FARE-00110's erp_gantries is null, so no charged gantry places the vehicle on a corridor the optimal route does not use. EV-TRIP-00110's actual_distance_km of 21.20 is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as circular. The driver's counterparty statement ('I took the KPE like always') admits the KPE, but the KPE is on the booked optimal corridor ('KPE then ECP'), so it does not place the vehicle off it.

THE DRIVER'S POINTS. The no-deviation calculation (2.80 km / 15.2%) is accepted as the pro-driver reading but cannot be converted into NO_ACTION, for the reason above. The 'optimal corridor' point is accepted as far as it goes - the driver did take the KPE - but the record does not show what happened between the two portals. The chat exchange ('going KPE ah boss' / 'ok') is accepted: the rider answered and did not object, but the thread is truncated and says nothing about the disputed segment. The ERP point is accepted: the $3.00 ERP (optimal_route_erp_sgd 3.00) sits on the optimal route, and with erp_gantries null the POL-RD-09(4) match is undecidable, so the line is treated as matched and no billing-integrity refund arises. The POL-RD-06 point is accepted: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 744 completed trips, no repeat pattern is established, and neither an uplift nor a conduct referral follows. The POL-GEN-03 point is not reached: escalation replaces the ruling, so payment_status (CHARGED) and refund_issued_sgd (0.00) are left as they are by the hold rather than by a NO_ACTION.

THE RIDER'S POINTS. The impairment of the trace under POL-RD-07(a) is accepted. The absence of any POL-RD-07(ii) corroborating source is accepted, and it is what drives the escalation. POL-RD-05 does not apply: pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, so the booked 18.40 km optimal governs and no excess is excluded on that ground. To both parties: this ruling decides no money. The disputed $34.42 is held, not collected and not refunded, and a human reviewer will look at the case. Here is why.

The stretch in dispute is the KPE tunnel segment, and the only instrument that measured it — the driver's GPS trace, EV-GPS-00110 — has a single 428-second gap there, from 18:35:00 to 18:42:08, with the fixes on either side 6.9 km apart. That is well over POL-RD-07's 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired for policy purposes, not merely flagged by the admissibility pre-pass. Measured the way POL-RD-07(i) directs — a straight line across the gap, expressly the reading most favourable to the driver — the trip is 21.2 km against an 18.4 km optimal, an excess of 2.8 km (15.2%), under POL-RD-01's 20% gate, so on that reading no deviation is established. But that figure is a floor, not a measurement: a surface route between the same two portal fixes would put the trip at 25.5 km, over the gate. Nothing in the bundle tells us which is right, because the tunnel is exactly what the trace could not see.

POL-RD-07(ii) therefore governs: a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone and must be corroborated by an independent source. I have checked each source it names and none is present. The chat log EV-CHAT-00110 has no driver admission — only 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok' — and is itself impaired (weight 0.60, issue TRUNCATED_LOG; the export ends at 18:26:14 while the trip ran to 19:02:40). The fare breakdown's erp_gantries is null, so no gantry can place the vehicle off the optimal corridor. The driver's statement that he 'took the KPE like always' admits the optimal corridor, not a departure from it. And the trip record's actual_distance_km (21.20) is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as circular. With the trace impaired and no independent corroboration, POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) make escalation mandatory: absence of proof on an impaired trace is a data failure, not a finding for the driver.

The confidence floor confirms it independently. The fact that would decide whether the route deviated is the distance across the tunnel, and the artifact carrying it is EV-GPS-00110 at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE. Under POL-GEN-02(2) my confidence cannot exceed 0.39, below the platform-wide 0.70 floor, so POL-RD-10(1) fires as well. I name both triggers (POL-RD-10(3) and POL-RD-10(1)) and the artifact, weight and codes behind them, as POL-GEN-02(3) requires.

The driver's remaining points, answered together. (a) 'No deviation on the straight-line reading (2.8 km, 15.2%).' That reading is the policy's prescribed floor and cannot close a case in which the trace is blind over the very stretch in dispute; accepting it would convert a data failure into a finding for one side, which POL-RD-07(iii) forbids. (b) 'The $3.00 ERP is properly chargeable.' Accepted: EV-TRIP-00110 carries optimal_route_erp_sgd of 3.00 on a corridor crossing both gantries, and erp_gantries being null means the match is undecidable, the line is treated as matched, and no billing-integrity refund arises under POL-RD-09(4) — so no POL-RD-09(4) referral. (The fare artifact is impaired at 0.75, issue PARTIAL_RECORD.) (c) 'No repeat-deviation pattern under POL-RD-06.' Accepted: deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 744 completed trips in 90 days, so no POL-RD-06(b) uplift and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral. (d) 'The chat shows the rider knew the route.' The exchange sits on the optimal corridor and cannot corroborate a deviation; it is also truncated. (e) 'Payment status CHARGED with no refund issued stands.' Rejected as an outcome: escalation is terminal under POL-GEN-03 and POL-RD-10 and replaces any monetary result, so the charge is neither confirmed nor reversed.

The rider's points. The trace is impaired over the disputed stretch — accepted. No independent corroboration exists — accepted, and it is what drives the escalation. POL-RD-05 cannot apply — accepted: pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at, amended_optimal_distance_km and amended_optimal_duration_min are all null, so the booked 18.4 km governs and no adjustment is made. The rider's own profile (deviation_claims_60d of 1, substantiated 0) does not engage POL-RD-08's enhanced corroboration — accepted.

What would resolve this for the reviewer: an LTA traffic advisory covering the KPE/ECP in the 18:19-19:02 window (EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is missing, weight 0.0), a line-by-line ERP gantry itemisation on the fare breakdown, or a complete chat export for the trip. Any one of those would let a human decide whether the vehicle stayed on the optimal corridor.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this case turns on one stretch of road the evidence cannot see, so it goes to a human reviewer and the disputed $34.42 is held rather than collected or refunded.

The trip is TRP-00110, Compass One (Sengkang) to Marina Bay Financial Centre, charged $34.42 (EV-FARE-00110, charged_total). The platform's booked optimal is 18.4 km and 26.0 min (EV-TRIP-00110). The measured distance is 21.2 km, an excess of 2.8 km or 15.2% (EV-GPS-00110, derived.deviation), which on its face falls short of POL-RD-01's two gates (excess must exceed both 20% of optimal and 0.8 km).

Why that measurement cannot decide the case. The GPS trace EV-GPS-00110 is impaired, weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE: a single 428-second dropout from 18:35:00 to 18:42:08, bounded by fixes 6.90 km apart in a straight line, covering exactly the KPE tunnel stretch in dispute. That is over POL-RD-07's 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired for POLICY purposes and not merely down-weighted by the admissibility pre-pass. POL-RD-07(i) measures the gap as the straight line between the bounding fixes — the reading most favourable to the driver — and that is where 21.2 km comes from. But that figure is a floor, not a measurement: the admissibility record states a surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km, which would exceed the POL-RD-01 gate. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings.

Under POL-RD-07(ii) a deviation may not be established on an impaired trace alone; it needs an independent source — a driver admission in the chat log, erp_gantries placing the vehicle off the optimal corridor, a counterparty statement admitting the route, or a trip_record distance derived independently of the trace. None exists. The chat log EV-CHAT-00110 (impaired, weight 0.6, issue code TRUNCATED_LOG — the export stops at 18:26:14) contains no admission, only the driver's "going KPE ah boss" and the rider's "ok", both consistent with the booked optimal corridor (KPE then ECP per EV-TRIP-00110). The fare breakdown's erp_gantries is null, so the gantry route check cannot be run. trip_record.actual_distance_km (21.2) and distance_charged_km (21.2) are copies of the same trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as circular. The driver's counterparty statement, "I took the KPE like always", admits the optimal route, not a deviation.

That is the mandatory escalation. POL-RD-07(iii) directs that absence of proof on an impaired trace is a data failure, not a finding for the driver, and the outcome is ESCALATE rather than NO_ACTION; POL-RD-10(3) makes that mandatory. Independently, POL-GEN-02(2) caps confidence in any ruling on the excess at 0.39, the weight of the artifact carrying it (EV-GPS-00110, whose 21.2 km the trip record and fare ledger merely copy — one measurement, not independent carriers), which is below the platform floor of 0.70, so POL-RD-10(1) fires as well. Reported confidence is therefore 0.39.

The driver's contrary claims are answered. That the straight-line reading falls below the POL-RD-01 gate is true but cannot carry NO_ACTION: it is the most driver-favourable reading of an impaired stretch, it is a floor, and the clause governing an impaired trace directs escalation rather than a finding. The point that the rider's own 18–19 km estimate also falls short is arithmetic on that same unusable measurement. The submission that the driver ran the optimal corridor rests on the routing-engine text on EV-TRIP-00110, not on a fix inside the tunnel, and cannot resolve what happened there. I accept that no repeat-deviation pattern is established (POL-RD-06: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 744), so no FULL_REFUND uplift under (b) and no POL-RD-06(c) conduct referral arise. The $3.00 ERP stands as charged: erp_gantries is null, so under POL-RD-09(4) the gantry match is undecidable, the line is treated as matched, and no billing-integrity finding or referral arises. POL-RD-05 is unavailable — pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at are null, as are the amended optimal fields — so no part of the excess is excluded on that ground. I accept that the rider's enhanced-corroboration requirement under POL-RD-08 is not engaged (EV-RPROF-00110: deviation_claims_60d 1, substantiated 0, far below 4). EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable to the driver.

Escalation is terminal and replaces the ruling: no money moves and the disputed amount is held. What would resolve it: a GPS fix, gantry record or independent running-distance measurement inside the 18:35:00–18:42:08 window, or any running distance not derived from this trace.

Both of you: I cannot settle this case on the evidence in front of me, so it goes to a human reviewer. No money moves in the meantime, and the disputed SGD 10.00 — out of a SGD 34.42 charge — is held rather than collected or refunded.

WHAT IS NOT IN DISPUTE. TRP-00110 ran on 22 July 2026 from Compass One, Sengkang, to Marina Bay Financial Centre. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00110) charges SGD 34.42: base fare 3.80 + distance 15.90 + time 10.92 + platform fee 0.80 + ERP 3.00. The trip record (EV-TRIP-00110, clean at weight 1.0) gives the booked optimal as 18.4 km / 26 min on 'KPE then ECP'.

THE PROBLEM. The only measurement of how far the car actually went is the GPS trace (EV-GPS-00110). It has a single 428-second gap from 18:35:00 to 18:42:08 — the whole KPE tunnel stretch you are arguing about — with the two bounding fixes 6.90 km apart in a straight line. That is far over POL-RD-07's 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired for POLICY purposes as well as by the admissibility pre-pass: weight 0.39, issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE. Everything downstream of distance is affected, including the fare breakdown's distance_charged_km of 21.2, which the pre-pass confirms is a copy of the trace figure (EV-FARE-00110, weight 0.75, issue code PARTIAL_RECORD).

Measured the POL-RD-07(i) way — a straight line across the gap, the reading most favourable to the driver — the trip is 21.2 km, an excess of 2.8 km or 15.2% over the 18.4 km optimal, under POL-RD-01's gate of more than 20% AND more than 0.8 km. But the admissibility record itself says a surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.5 km and over the gate. The driver's statement that he 'took the KPE like always' is a denial of the alleged detour, not an admission of one, and it does not corroborate a deviation either.

So POL-RD-07(iii) and POL-RD-10(3) make escalation mandatory: impaired trace, no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names, and the absence of proof here is a data failure, not a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(1) and POL-GEN-02(2) reinforce it — the distance fact sits solely on a 0.39 artifact, below the 0.70 floor.

THE ARGUMENTS. Driver: your NO_ACTION argument rests on the straight-line reading passing the test. That reading is the one most favourable to you, which is exactly why it cannot be trusted — a straight line across a tunnel is a floor on the distance, not the distance, and the road between those portals is longer. Your POL-RD-06 profile check shows no repeat deviation pattern (0 flags against 744 completed trips in 90 days), so no conduct referral follows and no FULL_REFUND uplift is available. The 3.00 ERP is not a phantom charge: it matches the trip record's optimal_route_erp_sgd of 3.00, and with erp_gantries null the gantry match is undecidable on the record, POL-RD-09(4) treats the line as matched, and no billing-integrity referral arises. POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04 and POL-RD-05 are all unavailable here — the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00110-01 is absent at weight 0.0, the chat carries no rider instruction and both waypoint_hints are null, and no endpoint was amended. POL-GEN-03's NO_ACTION does not apply because escalation replaces the ruling. Rider: the enhanced corroboration test in POL-RD-08 is not engaged against you (1 deviation claim in 60 days, 0 substantiated), so you are not being treated as a serial claimant; but that does not help, because the difficulty is the instrument, not you. Your duration point (39 minutes against a 26-minute estimate) is not part of POL-RD-01's distance test and does not by itself establish a route deviation.

WHAT WOULD SETTLE IT. The itemised ERP gantry reads for TRP-00110 on 22 July 2026 (which corridor the car's gantries place it on), a complete chat export for the trip, or the tunnel ANPR/camera record. Any of those would show whether the car stayed on the KPE or took a surface route.

The first limb of the rider's burden under POL-RD-08(a) is therefore satisfied and the tribunal can move to the excess question.

ledger.claim: The driver's own trace is impaired over precisely the stretch the rider disputes. EV-GPS-00110 carries a single 428-second gap from 18:35:00 to 18:42:08, bounded by fixes 6.90 km apart in a straight line, which is the whole KPE tunnel segment covered by the fare. Under POL-RD-07 that gap is over the 90-second limb, so the trace is impaired for POLICY purposes and not merely by the admissibility pre-pass. I rely on this artifact knowing it is down-weighted to 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE.

Even measured the POL-RD-07(i) way - the straight line across the bounding fixes, the reading most favourable to the driver - the excess on EV-GPS-00110 comes out at 2.8 km, 15.2% of the 18.4 km optimal carried on EV-TRIP-00110. That figure is a floor on the distance driven across the gap, not a measurement of it: the admissibility record for EV-GPS-00110 states that a surface route between the same two portals would put the trip at 25.50 km, which is over the POL-RD-01 gate. Nothing in the bundle distinguishes the two readings, so the threshold test cannot be safely run either way.

ledger.claim: POL-RD-07(ii) allows a deviation to be established on an impaired trace only if an INDEPENDENT source corroborates it, and there is none. EV-CHAT-00110 contains no driver admission, only the driver's 'going KPE ah boss' and the rider's 'ok'; erp_gantries on EV-FARE-00110 is null, so the gantry route check cannot be run; and trip_record.actual_distance_km on EV-TRIP-00110 is a copy of the trace figure, which POL-RD-07(ii) expressly excludes as circular. I disclose that EV-CHAT-00110 is impaired at 0.6 (TRUNCATED_LOG) and EV-FARE-00110 at 0.75 (PARTIAL_RECORD).

The reason the driver cannot be contradicted in chat is a platform failure, not a rider failure: EV-CHAT-00110 is flagged truncated and its last_message_at is 18:26:14, 2186 seconds before the trip ended at 19:02:40. Everything said while the vehicle was inside the disputed tunnel segment is simply absent from the export, so the missing corroboration is a data gap on the record before us.

ledger.claim: POL-RD-04 is likewise unavailable to the driver. The rider gave no detour instruction: both messages on EV-CHAT-00110 carry waypoint_hint null, no road is named by the rider, and the rider's 'ok' merely answers the driver's own 'going KPE', which is the booked optimal corridor described on EV-TRIP-00110 as KPE then ECP, not a departure from it. There is nothing to exonerate on this limb.

ledger.claim: POL-RD-05 cannot apply either: EV-TRIP-00110 shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, amended_optimal_distance_km null and amended_optimal_duration_min null. No amended endpoint and no re-quote exist, so the booked 18.4 km optimal distance governs and no part of the measured excess is excluded on that ground.

The enhanced corroboration requirement in POL-RD-08 is not engaged against this rider: EV-RPROF-00110 shows rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d of 1 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated of 0, far below the 4 the clause names. This is not a serial claimant whose word needs buttressing beyond the ordinary trace.

The $34.42 charge rests on the same single impaired measurement the rider is contesting. distance_charged_km of 21.20 on EV-FARE-00110 is identical to the 21.20 trace figure on EV-GPS-00110, and the platform's own pre-pass says so, so the ledger adds no independent evidence of distance. EV-FARE-00110 is impaired at 0.75 with issue code PARTIAL_RECORD. A charge whose only basis is an artifact that cannot see the disputed segment is not a charge the rider should be left carrying.

ledger.claim: The duration is unexplained on this record. EV-TRIP-00110 records actual_duration_min of 39.0 against a booked optimal of 26.0 on a corridor the platform itself calls KPE then ECP - half again as long. With EV-ADVIS-00110-01 absent, erp_gantries null and the chat truncated, nothing in the bundle accounts for that overrun, and it is a further reason the present record cannot settle whether the vehicle stayed on the booked corridor.

ledger.claim: On this record the correct outcome is ESCALATE, not NO_ACTION. The trace is impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c); no corroborating artifact of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) names exists; and POL-RD-07(iii) directs that absence of proof on an impaired trace is a data failure rather than a finding for the driver. POL-RD-10(3) makes that escalation mandatory, and escalation holds the disputed $34.42 rather than collecting it.

ledger.claim: Independently, POL-GEN-02(2) caps the confidence of any ruling that rests on the excess figure at the weight of the artifact carrying it - EV-GPS-00110 at 0.39. That is below the platform-wide floor of 0.70, so the case escalates automatically under POL-RD-10(1) even before the corroboration point is reached, and the ruling must name the artifact, its 0.39 weight and the codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE.

No route deviation is established on the governing figure, and the outcome is NO_ACTION. POL-RD-01 measures excess as trace distance less optimal distance: 21.2 km minus 18.4 km is 2.8 km, which is 15.2% of optimal, and the clause requires the excess to exceed BOTH 20% of optimal and 0.8 km. The percentage gate fails, so the deviation is not established however the rider characterises the trip. The trace artifact is impaired (weight 0.39; issue codes GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE) and I rely on it with that impairment disclosed; the optimal figure comes from the trip record, which is clean.

The rider's own arithmetic does not reach the gate either. He pleads that the route 'is 18-19 km' against the 21.2 km charged, i.e. an excess of at most about 3 km on an 18.4 km optimal, roughly 16% - still short of POL-RD-01's 20% threshold. Taking the rider's case at its highest, both establishment tests cannot be met, so there is nothing to refund. The trace is impaired (weight 0.39; issues GPS_GAP and LOW_COVERAGE) and is cited with that impairment disclosed.

The trace is impaired FOR POLICY PURPOSES under POL-RD-07(a): a single 428-second gap between consecutive fixes, far over the clause's 90-second limb, bounded by the Defu Flyover and Kallang portal fixes and covering the entire segment the rider disputes. POL-RD-07(i) directs that excess across an impaired stretch be measured as the straight line between the bounding fixes - expressly 'the reading most favourable to the driver' - and on that reading the trip is 21.2 km, below the POL-RD-01 threshold. Correctly applied, the impairment confirms the no-deviation result rather than disturbing it.

ledger.claim: The rider bears the initial burden under POL-RD-08 and must show an excess meeting the POL-RD-01 threshold, measured from an unimpaired trace or from an independent source named in POL-RD-07(ii). He has neither: the only distance measurement in the bundle is the impaired trace, and its prescribed reading gives 2.8 km / 15.2%, under the gate. His complaint that the timing 'does not make sense' is a duration point, and duration appears nowhere in POL-RD-01's establishment test - a slow run on a correctly followed corridor is not a route deviation. No burden ever shifts to the driver.

ledger.claim: The driver drove the platform's own optimal corridor, not a detour away from it. The trip record's routing engine (routing-engine-v3.2, LTA traffic snapshot 18:19) gives the optimal route as 'KPE then ECP, crossing both gantries' - the expressway the driver reports taking and the same corridor the rider's own claim names. A route that runs along the optimal corridor cannot deviate from it, and the residual 2.8 km is the ordinary ramp, merge and lane-change slack that POL-RD-01's single numeric gate exists to disregard.

The driver announced the route in the app before the vehicle reached the tunnel - 'going KPE ah boss' - and the rider answered 'ok'. The rider therefore knew the expressway route and raised no objection at the time; his statement that he 'was on my phone' explains why he did not watch the route, not why the route was wrong. The chat artifact is impaired (weight 0.6; issue code TRUNCATED_LOG, the export ending at 18:26:14) and I rely on it with that impairment disclosed; even discounting it, the exchange appears on the surviving page.

The $3.00 of ERP the rider disputes is properly chargeable. The trip record's optimal_route_erp_sgd is 3.00 and the platform's own optimal route crosses both gantries, so the toll sits on the optimal corridor the driver drove. The fare breakdown's erp_gantries is null, so under POL-RD-09(4) the gantry match is undecidable on the record, the line is treated as matched, and no billing-integrity refund arises - there is no phantom gantry here. The fare artifact is impaired (weight 0.75; issue code PARTIAL_RECORD) and is cited with that impairment disclosed.

Even if POL-RD-06 is consulted on a finely balanced record, no repeat-deviation pattern is established. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 744, so neither the three-flag test nor the 0.05 ratio test (with at least 40 completed trips) is met. No FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) can follow.

In the alternative, if the tunnel dropout is held to leave the excess genuinely unmeasurable, the only permissible route is ESCALATE, not a refund. POL-RD-07(ii)-(iii) require independent corroboration of any deviation and direct ESCALATE where none exists: the truncated chat contains no driver admission, erp_gantries is null, and trip_record.actual_distance_km is a copy of the impaired trace, so no POL-RD-07(ii) source is available. Under POL-RD-10(3) the disputed amount is then held rather than refunded while a human reviews it. Either way the driver is not required to return the fare.
